From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, infra-planning@acmecloud.com

Subject: Helios pilot: SprintFlex capacity gate & temporary autoscale carveout

Team,

We have a firm commitment for a week-long demo (Helios pilot) with ACME starting the week of July 13. Product wants consistent p95/99 latency under a controlled traffic profile for the customer-facing demo and a 48-hour soak before launch. To hit that we need two things from Dedicated/Capacity:

- A temporary carveout from the standard autoscaling policy: disable burst downscaling for the Helios dedicated slice so the canary traffic doesn't get evicted during the demo window.
- A short-lived reservation of a SprintFlex slice sized for 4x average concurrent requests (see attached capacity matrix v3).

Attached: helios_capacity_matrix_v3.xlsx (expected steady-state and stress curves), helios_canary_runbook.pdf (ops checklist).

Ask: Can Ops approve a temporary autoscale exception and carve a SprintFlex slice for Jul 11-20 (includes 48hr soak)? If yes, what approval path and what SLAs are required from Product/Customer?

Next steps I propose: ops + product sync tomorrow 9am PT to validate numbers, then procurement handshake with ACME for the reservation fee.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks for the context. A few quick operational clarifications before we commit: 

1) Scope: Is this SprintFlex carveout limited to one physical pool (us-west-2:gpu-pool-12) or cross-region? If we lock cross-region it increases coordination overhead.
2) Autoscale exception: we can disable scale-in for the slice, but we need a fallback policy (pre-authorized model downgrade) if background demand spikes. Who owns fallback decision at runtime?
3) Cost/chargeback: procurement will need an order total. Marissa, can your team confirm the internal billing code (we'll need it for the MOU)?

Operational ask: can Product sign off on the fallback runbook and a 4‑hour on-call window for infra during the demo? If yes, Ops can provision a SprintFlex reservation and lock scale-in for Jul 11–20 pending procurement sign-off.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Dedicated Capacity Operations
